init_sequence.notes: Power On command may be omitted.
After VCC is supplied, hold DVI low for at least 1 us to ensure asynchronous reset and Power Down state.
Optional: send Power On before measurement commands.
Optional: reset illuminance data register after Power On if previous measurement result should be cleared.
Use a default conservative measurement mode: continuously H-Resolution Mode.

transaction.notes: Send measurement command then read 2 bytes from the data register.

read_sequence.notes: For continuous modes, wait for the measurement time to complete before reading the result.
Combine returned bytes as high byte [15:8] then low byte [7:0].

timing_constraints.name: dvi_reset_low_minimum
timing_constraints.notes: set to 'L' ( at least 1µs, DVI <= 0.4V ) after VCC is supplied

conversion_formulae.name: illuminance_from_data
conversion_formulae.formula: Illuminance in lux is derived from the 16-bit measurement result. Datasheet examples show lux = raw / 1.2 for the default MTreg = 69 in H-resolution mode, and lux scales inversely with MTreg.

conversion_formulae.name: illuminance_mtreg_adjusted
conversion_formulae.formula: For H-resolution mode, lx/count = 1 / 1.2 * (69 / X), where X is MTreg. For H-resolution mode2, divide by 2 again.

evidence_spans.snippet: Slave Address is 2 types, it is determined by ADDR Terminal
After about 240ms, measurement result is registered to Data Register.
H-Resolution Mode Measurement Time               t HR     ...   Typ.    120    180        ms
L-Resolution Mode Measurement Time               t LR     ...   Typ.     16     24        ms
Data Register → This is for registration of Ambient Light Data. Initial Value is "0000_0000_0000_0000".
Measurement Time Register → This is for registration of measurement time. Initial Value is "0100_0101".
H-reslution mode : Illuminance per 1 count ( lx / count )    = 1 / 1.2 *( 69 / X )
H-reslution mode2 : Illuminance per 1 count ( lx / count )    = 1 / 1.2 *( 69 / X ) / 2
DVI is I 2 C bus reference voltage terminal. And it is also asynchronous reset terminal. It is necessary to set to 'L' after VCC is supplied.

requires_human: The datasheet outline says 'Electrical Characteristics ( VCC = 3.0V, DVI = 3.0V ... )'; confirm whether 'DVI' is intended as the I2C reference voltage pin name or a typo in the outline context. The terminal table explicitly uses DVI.

The datasheet shows MTreg default 0100_0101 (69) and formulas using X=MTreg, but does not explicitly define how to write the default MTreg value beyond the split high-bit and low-bit command opcodes; confirm whether the driver should program MTreg on init or rely on power-up default.
The datasheet states 'Power On' command is possible to omit; confirm whether the recommended init sequence should actually send Power On on all boards or skip it when starting from Power Down.

The 'After about 240ms' note conflicts with the 120ms typical measurement time for H-resolution mode; confirm whether 240ms refers to a specific command path or includes extra margin and should not be used as default delay.
